rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single static image, but it introduces uncertainty/confusion about the reported 2AA stage and mentions possible collapse/edge detail not clearly established from the provided data.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrium, and day-5 development well, with appropriate emphasis on BMI as the main modifiable negative factor; could have more explicitly addressed the nonspecific diagnosis and fresh vs frozen context.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include the staging discussion and somewhat broad assumptions around euploidy/live birth estimates.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including caution about morphology-only assessment and reasonable transfer/future-cycle recommendations; slight deviation comes from overinterpreting implantation/live birth percentages and some nonessential commentary.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, luteal support adherence, uterine cavity review, and future planning including weight reduction and possible PGT-A; recommendations are useful though not highly tailored beyond standard IVF counseling.
